settings.text:
Life gets busy, so we’ve made it easy to get your rolls to us...
We collect from our drop-off boxes Monday to Friday, when we receive your order notification

Live Forever Lab (Street Level). 501 Crown Street, Surry Hills. 24 Hours
Live Forever Lab (Lab Door). 1st Floor, 501 Crown Street, Surry Hills.
The Soda Factory (Street Level). 16 Wentworth Ave, Surry Hills. 24 Hours
Title Store Barangaroo (In-Store). 400 Barangaroo Ave, Barangaroo .

settings.answer_1:
Use one of our film envelopes provided at the drop-off box and label it with your name and contact.

Plastic film tubs won’t fit, so if necessary place your film in a resealable bag for protection.
settings.answer_2:
Scan QR code on the box to create and submit your order.

Please submit the order at the same time you drop your film (your order notification lets us know we know that your rolls are awaiting collection).
settings.answer_3: Drop your film envelope in the box. Once we receive your order notification, we’ll collect it, send you a payment link, and start development.

settings.note: Note: Unfortunately, we can’t guarantee envelopes will always be available at every drop-off location. If none are, please use secure wrapping and include your contact details.

settings.title: Pack it
settings.content: Use the envelope provided at the drop box, and add your name, phone, and email.

settings.title: Place your order
settings.content: Scan the QR code or [click here] to order. Pay now or choose to pay later (we’ll send a link once your film arrives).

settings.title: Label your roll
settings.content: Add your order number to the envelope.

settings.title: Drop it in
settings.content: Drop your roll in the drop-off box. We’ll collect, develop, and get your scans to you quickly.
